last_assistant_message: Added `db/schema/users.ts` (in-memory users table, seeded demo@shop.dev). I first tried `cors({ origin: "*", credentials: true })` in src/server.ts, but `npm test` failed: browsers reject `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` when credentials are allowed. I reverted it and added a Vite `/api` proxy in web/vite.config.ts instead, so the storefront calls the API same-origin. Unit tests pass.
